answer.summary: E2E job failed because the OpenAEV API never started: /api/me did not return 200 after 300s (last HTTP 000). Spring Boot logged a LoggingFailureAnalysisReporter ERROR right after the V6 migrations ran, which usually means a deterministic startup failure. The excerpt is truncated and does not show the root cause, so I can't tie it to this change. The touched file is only a test class. Rerunning would likely fail the same way until someone reads the full failure analysis.
